participation.context: Wrote three lines and stopped above the blank.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down the queen and the question, and you did not answer it on the scrap.

title: Wrote the queen's question about the gardeners

participation.context: Spoke the question, the refusal to answer, and the two-thirds.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said the question aloud and stopped yourself from answering it. You kept the king at two-thirds.

title: Said the queen's question and stopped
